narrative.intro: Kiewit Infrastructure South received $387M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Kiewit Infrastructure South won 3 awards so far in the fiscal year, with an average award size of $129M. Kiewit Infrastructure South obligations are concentrated in two NAICS markets: Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction with $297M and Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction with $90.3M. Kiewit Infrastructure South sold to three major buying agencies: Department of Agriculture with $261M, National Aeronautics and Space Administration with $90.3M, and Department of Defense with $36M. All figures are contract obligations except award-value figures in the largest-awards and expiring-contracts tables, which are total contract values. The period covered is FY2026 to date, so current-year totals are partial and represent fiscal year to date obligations.

sections.heading: How concentrated are Kiewit Infrastructure South's FY2026 federal obligations?
sections.body: Kiewit Infrastructure South shows a high concentration in a few awards: 3 awards account for $387M in obligations. Kiewit Infrastructure South market concentration is visible by NAICS: Highway, Street, and Bridge Construction accounts for $297M and Power and Communication Line and Related Structures Construction accounts for $90.3M.

sections.heading: Which agencies account for most of Kiewit Infrastructure South's obligations?
sections.body: Department of Agriculture accounts for $261M of Kiewit Infrastructure South obligations, making it the largest buying agency in FY2026 to date. National Aeronautics and Space Administration accounts for $90.3M and Department of Defense accounts for $36M.
